tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List devplane.dev's public, crawlable marketing pages (home, explain, compare, faq) with route, canonical URL, title and description. Excludes the secret-gated internal editor.

tools.name: list_faqs
tools.description: List every question/answer pair from https://devplane.dev/faq — 10 questions on multi-agent orchestration, operator cockpits, diagnosis, and comparisons, answered directly.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Get one FAQ entry by slug (from the list_faqs catalog), e.g. what-is-multi-agent-orchestration.

tools.name: list_comparisons
tools.description: List every comparison from https://devplane.dev/compare — DevPlane vs. a single AI assistant, vs. an issue tracker, and multi-agent vs. single-agent — each with the full side-by-side dimension table and verdict.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_pages" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
